description: Server-side version history endpoints and types. Add the flow controller with two routes: GET /rule-engine/flows/:id/versions (proxy to engine listFlowVersions) and POST /rule-engine/flows/:id/rollback (proxy to engine rollbackFlow). The AdminClient already has these methods; this FEAT adds the CMS proxy layer so the admin UI can call them through Strapi's admin auth.
steps: 1. Create cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/controllers/flow.ts following sync.ts pattern: factory with strapi + fetchImpl injection, createClient() helper, handleApiError() helper. Implement getVersions(ctx) calling client.listFlowVersions(ctx.params.id), and rollback(ctx) calling client.rollbackFlow(ctx.params.id, ctx.request.body.version).
2. Register the flow controller in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/index.ts: import flowController and add to controllers object as 'flow'.
3. Add two routes to cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/routes/index.ts: GET /flows/:id/versions handler 'flow.getVersions', POST /flows/:id/rollback handler 'flow.rollback'.

4. Create cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/flow.test.ts following sync.test.ts pattern: use nock + httpFetch shim, test getVersions returns versions list, test rollback calls engine and returns new active version, test error handling for 404/5xx.
acceptance_criteria: GET /rule-engine/flows/:id/versions returns { flowId, versions: [...] } from engine
POST /rule-engine/flows/:id/rollback with { version } body returns { flowId, activeVersion, action }
503 returned for engine unavailable (5xx), 404 echoed for missing flow
findings: Flow controller implemented with getVersions and rollback methods. Routes registered at GET /flows/:id/versions and POST /flows/:id/rollback. Types ListFlowVersionsResponse, VersionSummary, and SetActiveResponse from cms/types/engine.ts are used by the controller. FEAT-002 can import these types for the UI components.
